extracted.name: Salted Peanut Cookies
extracted.description: Salted cookies with peanuts recipe includes brown sugar, vanilla, shortening, and salted peanuts. If you use self-rising flour, omit baking soda and salt.
instruction_lines: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees F (190 degrees C). Lightly grease baking sheets.

Beat brown sugar, shortening, eggs, and vanilla extract in a large bowl until light and fluffy, 3 to 4 minutes. Sift flour into a separate bowl; whisk in salt and baking soda. Stir flour mixture into brown sugar mixture; stir in peanuts.
Drop dough by rounded teaspoons 2 inches apart onto the prepared baking sheets. Flatten dough with the bottom of a greased glass dipped in sugar.
Bake in the preheated oven until golden brown, 8 to 10 minutes.
